campus.title: Our Campus | YES College
campus.textPreview: Our Campus | YES College Skip to main content Our Campus Our Campus Our purpose built College Campus is conveniently located at Level 3, 106 Church Street, in the suburb of Parramatta in Sydney, New South Wales. The College Campus is only a short 3 to 4 minute walk from Parramatta train station, and is directly opposite one of Sydney’s largest and most popular shopping centres, Parramatta Westfields. There is an abundance of food options near the Campus, such as Japanese, Korean, Indian, Chinese, Australian, Italian and Middle Eastern, as well as chemists, retail shops, and public transport options. Parramatta is a buzzing commercial and city hub, and there are many fun community events to attend and be part of. You will feel immediately welcomed as you enter our Campus and are greeted by our lovely Receptionists and glowing chandeliers. Our theory classrooms are equiped with the latest audio/visual equipment to make our lessons more engaging, whilst our practical rooms replicate a real Salon and include beauty beds, beauty stations and mirrors, so you will feel as if you are already working in industry. Our students use the computer labs to study, print, photocopy, complete their assessments and browse the internet, and after classes, relax in the student break out area where they can keep their lunch refrigerated, heat up some hot meals, and eat. Our friendly student services support team are also at the Campus, and are ready to assist students with a vast range of things such as finding a job and accommodation, letting them know their academic results and timetable, and providing career, education and welfare counselling. Home / Our Campus

about.title: Why choose YES College? | YES College
about.textPreview: Why choose YES College? | YES College Skip to main content Why choose YES College? Business College Sydney MVJ Enterprises Pty Ltd trading as YES College, Perth College of Beauty Therapy is a Registered Training Organisation (RTO Code: 0249) and CRICOS Provider (CRICOS Code: 03282E). We take pride in our students’ achievements so are constantly in contact with industry to ensure you receive the most up-to-date training in Australia. Our courses offer a blend of theoretical and practical activities to ensure our graduates are skilled and ready for entry into the workforce. We are conveniently located on 2 – 4 minutes’ walk from Parramatta Train Station and opposite Westfield’s Shopping Centre Parramatta. Prior to opening our business college in Parramatta, MVJ Enterprises Pty Ltd has been trading as Perth College of Beauty Therapy from Perth (Western Australia) delivering quality training for over 30 years. There are only a few private training organisations in Australia which have over three decades of long and steady trading background and history. MVJ Enterprises Pty Ltd is a Registered Training Organisation (RTO) and provides training according to national competency standards and guidelines. We are also registered and accredited by two international examining bodies VTCT and ITEC, are registered on the Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Courses for Overseas Students (CRICOS), and are Austudy approved. Our WA branch, Perth College of Beauty Therapy, was originally set up as a training company by Beverly Stone in 1987 before there was anything like Registered Training Organisations. In the 1980’s vocational education as it was, was restricted to government TAFE’s. The first private RTO’s did not start to appear until late 1992 and earlier 1993 following the establishment of the Australian National Training Authority (ANTA). As Perth College of Beauty Therapy was first registered in February 1994, it is amongst the oldest private RTO’s in the country still operating. At its establishment in 1987, Perth College of Beauty Therapy operated from Subiaco, Western Australia and relocated in 1998 to 350 Albany Highway, Victoria Park, Western Australia. In 2017 MVJ Enterprises Pty Ltd expanded its operations and opened its Sydney branch; YES College, located at Suite 301, 106 Church Street, Parramatta, NSW 2150. The premises is conveniently located 2 – 4 minutes’ walk from Parramatta train station (opposite Parramatta Westfield) and includes brand new classrooms, equipped with power point projectors, trainer computers and white boards, on campus salons, student computer labs, a student reference library, student services and admin offices, meeting rooms, a student break out area, staff kitchen, and male and female, disability toilets. student_services.title: Student Services | YES College
student_services.textPreview: Student Services | YES College Skip to main content Student Services Support Services available to you As a Student of YES College, you can rest assured knowing that you have friendly and qualified support staff available to assist you before, during and after your studies. Our support team is available from Monday to Friday, 9am – 5pm and will help you with any questions you may have. Admissions and Enrolment Our Admissions Team will provide you with all the necessary information you need to make an informed decision about studying with us. Prior to enrolment, we will provide you with information on course entry requirements, fees, payment terms, our refund policy, college policies and procedures, our services, and information about your course, such as units of competency, duration, modes of delivery, assessment and recognition of prior learning. Some of our courses have strict entry requirements which are in place to make sure all students who are accepted will be able to successfully participate and progress through the course. If you do not meet the entry requirements, we will inform you of the reasons why and you may be able to enrol with us at a later stage once you have met the minimum requirements. Document and Records Access If you need access to any of your records during your studies such as Attendance Reports, Academic Results, Enrolment Letters, Holiday Letters, Forms, Statement of Completion and Academic Transcripts, simply visit Reception at our Parramatta campus and let them know. We are usually able to provide the requested documents on the same day, however please allow up to three days to receive your documents. This service is free, however if you need a re-print of certain official documents that have already been give to you but you have lost, such as Statements of Attainment or Testamurs, additional charges will apply. Education Counselling and Support We regularly monitor the progress of our students to make sure they are progressing satisfactorily and will be able to complete within their expected time. Should you be experiencing any difficulties in progressing satisfactorily we can provide a range of services to help you overcome any educational barriers you may be facing. Some of the education support services we offer includes organising mentoring, english language support, study skills support and academic writing support classes. We can also refer you to external organisations who may be able to assist you better, which are subject to additional fees. Welfare Counselling During your studies you may encounter personal problems that may end up affecting your enrolment. This can include the stress of being away from family and friends, difficulty in finding suitable accommodation, difficulty with work, personal issues at home, financial Issues e.t.c. Our Student Services Team is here to assist you as needed. If you are experiencing stress or difficult issues, please let our Student Services Team know about it. Co
